# Comfort

Comfort is a minimal, Japanese-inspired light theme with matcha tones, removed edge lines and a clearer interface. It uses the SimSun font and soft backgrounds for readability.

![Comfort screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carrie999/comfort/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Comfort"
    author: "carrie999"
    repo:   "carrie999/comfort"
    slug:   "comfort"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/comfort"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/carrie999/comfort"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carrie999/comfort/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a clean, minimal, Japanese-inspired light theme to Obsidian with matcha tones, removed edge lines, and a clearer UI. Use SimSun font and soft backgrounds for improved readability and a calming workspace."
}
```
